title: Docs gallery
description:
This PR adds additional examples to the gallery. Change anything you want (feel free to add commits here)! I ran out of time, but wanted to at least put some ideas out there!

It makes 2 main changes...

* Relabels categories. All the names ending in "Plots" hit a bit funny (but feel free to change to w/e!)
* Added notebooks for geom_area, labs, and theme_classic
  - note that theme_classic also has a theme_bw example. This is mostly because I ran out of time, but wanted it on the gallery 😓.

Note the following:

* The first chart under lines and paths feels like it should be second. (But this is not currently controllable).
* I could see us adding pieces for...
  - Facets
  - Scales (e.g. scale_x_log10, etc..)

![image](https://github.com/has2k1/plotnine-examples/assets/2574498/5403e046-764f-470b-acb4-7950445f92cb)

title: Add geom_density examples
description:
I had a fair bit of trouble working out how to scale geom_density properly so added some examples to help others.

Additionally the Makefile seems to use some non-POSIXy stuff so I've forced it to use `bash` as its shell (it was failing on my system which I guess uses `dash`).

title: Fix geom_col
description: In the `geom_col` example, the order of the columns in the income category does not respect what was in the DataFrame and the logical order: from "Lo" to "High". This PR fixes it and makes the example consistent by always referring to `geom_col`.

title: Created example notebook for plots updated with ipywidgets.
description:
This simple example shows how ipywidgets can be used to *interactively* select sub-sets of data to be plotted with plotnine.

ipywidgets have to be installed and activated (used version 7.1.2).

Even using the "matplotlib.pyplot.tight_layout" function, the initial plotnine figure show part of the legend outside the figure box. Manually resizing the figure (dragging the corner to increase the figure size) fixes the rendering issue, but I don't know how to fix the issue automatically.

title: Added box plot examples
description:
Thank you for the great lib. Plotnine has obvious lack of documentation, and I want to help you a little bit with it :)

Examples based on [ggplot2 docs](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/geom_boxplot.html).

title: order-plot-series: Show limits&reverse, adjust to current pandas syntax
description:
This change shows how to change the order by setting limits on discrete axis,
how to use the new reverse (see https://github.com/has2k1/plotnine/pull/254),
and replaces the somewhat clunky old-school categorical with the current pandas.Categorical syntax
and assign instead of df['column'] = something (which may or may not work with the infamous setting-on-a-copy-warning).

It also removes the notion that it has to be an ordered Categorical - any Categorical works as long as the 'cats' are in the right order.
